referral.reason_text: Mrs Catherine Doyle, 61, found to have iron deficiency, Hb 112. Colonoscopy in October was normal. Please advise on further work-up.

deciding.fast_track_met: Age 61 with low ferritin 8 and Hb 111 meets the iron deficiency anaemia criterion as documented. The normal colonoscopy in October makes the fast-track doubtful.
deciding.vetting_outcome: The normal colonoscopy (2024-10-08) and discharge support returning with advice. The unresolved anaemia leaves routine acceptance defensible.
deciding.first_contact: The reason text ends with a request to advise on further work-up, and the colonoscopy is recent and normal. A written reply to the GP fits.
deciding.clinical_urgency: Low Hb and ferritin are partly explained by the normal colonoscopy, and symptoms are stable. Whether the anaemia counts as an unexplained red flag (level 2) or not (level 1) is open.
deciding.record_agreement: Reason text says Hb 112 against 111 in results, and the name is Catherine vs Katherine. Both are trivial and the rest agrees.
